profiles.summary: The EVM crates of the production celo-reth tag are byte for byte the crates.io releases, so the Celo interpreter is stock revm-interpreter 35.0.1 on ruint 1.20.0. No celo-reth release with revm 42 has been tagged. All script sets and vectors pass again, and forno still serves the op-geth backend on about one request in five.

deltas.delta: celo/reth-v1.0.10 takes revm-interpreter 35.0.1, revm-bytecode 10.0.0, revm-handler 18.1.0 and revm-context 16.0.1 from celo-org/revm at bd28f94. Every .rs file under src of those four crates (35, 12, 16 and 10 files) is byte identical to the crates.io release of the same version. The jump destination analysis, the instruction table, the journal and transient storage code are therefore upstream code.

celo/reth-v1.0.10 pins alloy-primitives 1.6.0 without the fixed-cache dependency, so its KECCAK256 does not pass through the alloy keccak cache. celo-kona main pins alloy-primitives 1.7.3 with fixed-cache 0.1.10, so the next release may add the cache.

On 2026-11-24, 4 of 20 batched web3_clientVersion requests to forno.celo.org were answered by Geth/v0.1.0-untagged-c7ed55b8-20260817 and 16 by reth/v2.2.0-74cc8bb. The mixed backend recorded in F-116 is unchanged.

profiles.summary: The celo-revm handler on celo-kona main clears the transient storage written by the CIP-64 fee debit before the user's call starts and commits the transaction journal with the upstream commit_tx. Nothing about transaction boundaries changed for the PoolManager.

deltas.delta: celo-kona main crates/celo-revm/src/handler.rs brackets the CIP-64 debit in a journal checkpoint, clears the debit's transient storage on success (around line 698) and calls journal commit_tx at the end of execution_result unless the handler runs a non-committing system call (lines 1380-1402).

profiles.summary: Nothing new on the gas token for this cycle's focus. The refund clamp for a negative refund counter after a CIP-64 debit (Karst and later) changes gas only.

deltas.delta: celo-kona main sets the refund counter to zero when a CIP-64 debit left it negative and Karst is active, and states that the main call can be over or undercharged by about 2,800 gas per slot the debit wrote. This is a gas difference for the fee payer, not a change to a value the PoolManager reads.

profiles.summary: The transfer precompile on celo-kona main keeps the three guards read in earlier cycles: it halts in static context, below 9,000 gas and for any caller other than the CELO token. Known weaknesses since cycle 9 are the reth trie seek boundary bug (state roots and proofs, no execution result) and a TLS root removal.

deltas.delta: celo-kona main moved the transfer precompile at 0xfd to an alloy-evm DynPrecompile. It halts when is_static is set, when gas is below 9,000, when the caller is not the chain's CELO token, and when the input is not 96 bytes, then moves value with the journal's transfer. Before Jovian it restores the cold status of both accounts.

celo-reth v1.0.9 (5 November 2026) carries the reth trie seek boundary fix, and v1.0.8 (28 October 2026) removes a distrusted root certificate. The trie bug can make a node compute a wrong state root or serve a wrong eth_getProof and does not change an opcode result.

profiles.summary: The endpoint still reports reth/v2.3.0-f60420a xlayer/v0.0.7, which matches the okx/reth revision of v0.0.7.3-rc.1. ruint 1.18.0 is inside the range of RUSTSEC-2026-0220, and revm-interpreter 37.0.3 clamps every shift and byte index before it reaches ruint. The binary links the alloy keccak cache code, and the cache vectors pass.

deltas.delta: xlayer-reth v0.0.7.3-rc.1 pins ruint 1.18.0, below the patched 1.20.0 of RUSTSEC-2026-0220 (truncated shift amounts in wrapping shifts, wrong overflow flags).

The lockfile lists fixed-cache 0.1.10 as a dependency of alloy-primitives 1.6.0, so a feature that turns on the alloy keccak cache is active in the workspace. The bin/node crate has no default features and bin/reth of upstream reth, which turns on keccak-cache-global by default, is not used. Whether KECCAK256 itself goes through the cache in the X Layer binary was not settled by reading.

The chain spec of v0.0.7.3-rc.1 ends at Jovian (mainnet timestamp 1764691201) and has no Karst or Osaka entry. The hard fork of 10 November 2026 paired op-node xlayer/v0.1.7 with xlayer-reth v0.0.7.3 and changed gasless handling and Flashblocks metadata.

profiles.summary: The gasless check runs an uncommitted system call to the whitelist contract before each zero priced transaction. It touches only that contract and changes no state the PoolManager reads.

deltas.delta: For every non-deposit transaction with max fee per gas 0, the block executor of okx/optimism xlayer/v0.1.7 calls getGaslessAllowance(to, input) on 0x19787404b0c70021b4752028f7e3a92313885B27 from the system address without committing, and treats the transaction as gasless when the call returns true and the transaction's gas limit is within the returned allowance.

profiles.summary: The gasless whitelist is keyed on the target address and calldata, not the sender. The PoolManager, the PositionManager and both Universal Routers are not on it, and the gasless rule only skips the fee charge.

deltas.delta: The GASLESS_WHITELIST predeploy at 0x19787404b0c70021b4752028f7e3a92313885B27 (1,059 bytes of code) answered getGaslessAllowance with (false, 0) for the PoolManager, the PositionManager and the Universal Routers 0xda00ae15d3a71466517129255255db7c0c0956d3 and 0x1cd182C94fcF42277B80DBB9060F88024809E61E with the unlock, execute, modifyLiquidities and initialize selectors and with empty calldata.
deltas.source: https://rpc.xlayer.tech eth_getCode and eth_call getGaslessAllowance(address,bytes) at block 0x4933197, 2026-11-24

deltas.delta: The op-revm handler of okx/optimism xlayer/v0.1.7 skips the L1 fee, the operator fee and the gas fee for a gasless transaction and still requires the sender's balance to cover the transaction value.

profiles.summary: Known weaknesses since cycle 9: the reth trie fix in v0.0.7.3-rc.1, a public issue that lists configuration and logging defects of the node, and the gasless base fee bypass fix. None changes an opcode result or a PoolManager balance.

deltas.delta: Issue 276 of okx/xlayer-reth (June 2026, open) lists thirteen defects in argument parsing, genesis loading from environment variables, legacy RPC forwarding and Flashblocks handling. Each needs control of the node's configuration or the sequencer's payload path.

okx/optimism xlayer/v0.1.7 fixes a gasless base fee bypass so it applies only to the intended transaction. The comment at rust/alloy-op-evm/src/lib.rs lines 354-362 says the disable_base_fee flag is now saved and restored around each gasless execution so it does not leak into the next transaction of the block, because the executor and the builder reuse one EVM per block. A leaked bypass would let a zero priced transaction skip the base fee check, which is a fee matter set by the sequencer path and reads nothing the PoolManager uses.

cleared.check: Rerun of battery.py and targeted.py on forno.celo.org and rpc.xlayer.tech.
cleared.result: Battery: 99,985 of 99,985 vectors on both networks with 0 mismatches and 0 errors. Targeted: 85,544 of 85,544 on both with 0 mismatches. These cover the MULMOD, SAR, SIGNEXTEND, SDIV, SMOD, BYTE, SHL, SHR and DIV edges that FullMath, TickMath, BitMath, TickBitmap and SqrtPriceMath rely on (src/libraries/BitMath.sol:16-22, src/libraries/TickBitmap.sol:38, 67, 73).

cleared.check: Rerun of pmdiff (250 scripts), pmdiff2 (300 scripts) and pmdiff5 (149 extreme price scripts) with the bytecode built from this checkout.
cleared.result: pmdiff 250 of 250 identical to the stored Ethereum reference on both networks. pmdiff2 300 of 300 identical, including the native payout scripts. pmdiff5 137 of 137 compared scripts equal to the reference interpreter on both networks (12 left out as too long for the reference, as in OPCODES.md). The Celo requests went through forno without backend tagging, so they may mix the two backends; cycle 9 already ran pmdiff and pmdiff2 on each backend separately.

cleared.check: Mined swaps since the last run: tick relation, single step formulas and step replay (swaps.py, replay.py).
cleared.result: Celo: 90 swaps, all 90 pass the tick relation; 75 paired, 70 match a single step outcome to the unit (51 exact input, 17 exact output, 2 reaching the target) and 5 multi step swaps all replay to the unit. X Layer: 564 swaps, all pass; 537 paired, 536 single step exact and 1 multi step that replays. These ran in blocks built by the sequencers.

cleared.check: RUSTSEC-2026-0220 on X Layer, which pins ruint 1.18.0: can a SHL, SHR, SAR or BYTE amount of 2^32 or more, or a non limb aligned overflow flag, give a wrong result to TickBitmap, BitMath or the BalanceDelta and Slot0 unpacking.
cleared.result: No. revm-interpreter 37.0.3 (crates.io, the version X Layer pins) converts the amount with as_usize_saturated and calls the ruint shift only when it is below 256, returning zero or the sign fill otherwise; BYTE calls byte() only for an index below 32 (instructions/bitwise.rs lines 107-158). The advisory states the shifted values were correct and only the flags were wrong apart from the truncation above 2^32, which the guard excludes. ruint 1.18.0 byte() indexes the little endian limb slice directly (bits.rs lines 71-82). 3,045 new vectors with amounts k*2^32 + r, 2^64 + r, 2^128 + r and 2^255 + r for SHL, SHR, SAR, BYTE and SIGNEXTEND on seven values, each sent three times, gave 0 mismatches on both networks.

cleared.check: ruint fixes between 1.18.0 and 1.21.1 that could change an EVM result on X Layer: the div_3x2_ref fix of 1.21.0, the shift flag fix of 1.20.0 and the mul_mod fix of the unreleased branch.
cleared.result: div_3x2_ref is a reference function used only in tests; production division in knuth.rs and small.rs calls div_3x2, which is div_3x2_mg10 (src/algorithms/div/small.rs line 18). The mul_mod fix concerns the rewritten 1.21.0 path that 1.18.0 does not have. The shift fix is covered by the item above.

cleared.check: The alloy-primitives keccak cache in front of KECCAK256 on the two clients, for the 58 byte position key (src/libraries/Position.sol:60), the 64 byte delta and mapping slots (src/libraries/CurrencyDelta.sol:14) and the 160 byte pool id (src/types/PoolId.sol:14).
cleared.result: Celo's production tag does not link the cache (no fixed-cache dependency of alloy-primitives 1.6.0 in its lockfile). X Layer links it. In alloy-primitives 1.6.0 the cache key stores the length and all bytes and compares both, inputs of 0 bytes and above 87 bytes bypass it, and keccak256 uses it only with keccak-cache-global (src/utils/mod.rs lines 144-163, src/utils/keccak_cache.rs). The same 766 cache vectors as cycle 10, sent three times, gave 0 mismatches on both endpoints, so later rounds that would meet cache hits still return the specified hash.

cleared.check: Does the celo-org/revm fork at bd28f94 change any instruction, the jump destination analysis, the frame handler or the journal against the upstream release of the same version.
cleared.result: No. All 73 source files of revm-interpreter 35.0.1, revm-bytecode 10.0.0, revm-handler 18.1.0 and revm-context 16.0.1 fetched from the fork commit are byte identical to the crates.io packages. Celo specific behaviour lives in celo-revm and revm-precompile (the transfer precompile), which earlier cycles read.

cleared.check: Can the CIP-64 fee debit or credit on celo-kona main leave transient storage that a later frame of the user's transaction reads at the PoolManager (src/libraries/Lock.sol:13-25, src/libraries/CurrencyReserves.sol:17-36).
cleared.result: No. The debit's transient storage is cleared after the debit commits and before the main call (handler.rs around line 698). Transient storage is per contract, and the debit and credit system calls run in the registered fee currency, never in the PoolManager. Fee currencies are registered by governance.

cleared.check: Can an ordinary account use the X Layer gasless rule against PoolManager users.
cleared.result: No. A transaction is gasless only if the whitelist contract allows its target and calldata, and none of the PoolManager, PositionManager or Universal Router targets is allowed. The rule skips fees only; the PoolManager bytecode reads neither GASPRICE nor BASEFEE (OPCODES.md, bytecode level), and BASEFEE keeps the header value.

cleared.check: Known weaknesses of the last months for both clients: the reth trie seek boundary bug (0xCERT-2026-0317), celo-reth v1.0.4 to v1.0.10, celo-kona issue 182, xlayer-reth issue 276 and the dependency advisories.
cleared.result: The trie bug affects state roots and eth_getProof, not execution results; both clients shipped the fix (celo-reth v1.0.9, xlayer-reth v0.0.7.3-rc.1). Issue 182 was a local storage gap on one Celo node and a CIP-64 receipt attribution bug in an unreleased build, closed in June 2026. Issue 276 needs control of node configuration. None gives an ordinary account a path to PoolManager funds.

leads.question: When celo-kona tags a celo-reth release from main (revm 42.0.1, alloy-primitives 1.7.3 with fixed-cache 0.1.10), does the binary enable keccak-cache-global, and do the battery, the keccak cache vectors and the three script sets still pass on forno?
leads.why: It replaces the interpreter crate of Celo's only block producer and may add a process-wide cache in front of KECCAK256.

leadResults.answer: No celo-reth release carries revm 42 yet. The newest tag is celo/reth-v1.0.10 (celo/reth-v1.0.11 and v1.1.0 return 404), and it still takes revm-interpreter 35.0.1 from celo-org/revm bd28f94, whose interpreter, bytecode, handler and context sources are byte identical to crates.io. On main, the transfer precompile keeps the static, gas, caller and length guards, and the handler clears the debit's transient storage and commits the journal with commit_tx. The battery, targeted set and three script sets pass on forno today. The lead stays open for the first tagged release from main (new lead above).

Operator level. The rcs-filter config of xlayer-reth v0.0.7.3-rc.1 defaults to enabled false and needs a private RCS base URL (crates/rcs-filter/src/config.rs lines 24 and 69-71). No public source states the mainnet sequencer's setting and no documented denial of a transaction to 0x360e68faccca8ca495c1b759fd9eee466db9fb32 was found.
